Top Gate: recent changes

Leagues: 4 instead of 6

Wood 4: Up to 4 drones, drones bounce off each other, big gates.
Wood 3: Added CRASH and damage, BOOST, smaller gates, ladders and hairpins.
Wood 2: Added power cells (CHARGE, SHIELD, GHOST).
Wood 1: Drones are twice as powerful, added pylons, up to 3 boosts and harder tracks

Referee fixes:

- A race could freeze when a drone sat on the floor under a low ring. Fixed.
- Starts are now always at least 800 units in front of the first gate
- Eliminated bots are now ranked by how long they lasted.
- A huge number after CAM no longer gets you eliminated.
- When two drones reach the same power cell, it now goes to the one that got there first.

Statement:

- Formatting changes + renamed inputs to match the stubs
- The boost and power cell wording is clearer, and the Expert rules spell out when items take effect: a CHARGE at once, SHIELD and GHOST only when you USE them

Referee source: now public at https://github.com/francoisbeaussier/cg-topgate-referee (MIT).

Feedback welcome, especially on the new 4-league split and on how hard it is to reach Wood 1.

Do I need to make the Wood 2 Boss stronger or not?

Hi! Fun game, and awesome visualizer :) GG.

Found a few referee bugs. Repro file: https://gist.github.com/Pduhard/b93a97bcec86b0e3d6875f3951648832

1. One drone can freeze the race for everyone. Drone on the floor touching the bottom of a low ring: ring pushes it down, floor sets vz = 0, ring hits again, all at t = 0. The 64 events run out, nobody moves. Happens on its own (Bronze seed 9003, 4 bosses: ~100 frozen turns, all 4 die with 0 gates) or on purpose by parking under a low ring (Bronze seed 9001). Not sure it helps anyone win, but it kills the game. Tried locally: after a ring bounce, a drone on the floor keeps vz >= 0, and if the cap is hit everyone moves for the rest of the turn. 0 frozen turns on both seeds.

2. Drones can spawn touching a ring (Bronze seed 19). startFits() only checks walls. That's what starts the 9003 freeze.

3. From Silver: 3-ring ladders, corkscrews, arcs, vertical gates (Legend: on every track, arcs when they fit). Statement only mentions ladders and hairpins.

4. Start can be behind gate 0's plane, not 800 in front (tilted gate, drones start on the floor). Wood 1 seed 2.

5. All eliminated bots get setScore(-1), so they tie whatever the turn. Statement only mentions a tie for the same turn.

6. "CAM 99999999999" throws NumberFormatException, bot eliminated with 4 valid ints.

7. Cells: no item + SHIELD and GHOST in one move = both used, SHIELD only. Drone destroyed later in the move still uses the cell.

Repro: Repro.java in the source root, then
javac -d /tmp/tg src/main/java/topgate/sim/*.java src/main/java/topgate/bots/*.java
javac -cp /tmp/tg -d /tmp/tg Repro.java && java -cp /tmp/tg Repro

Thanks for the game!

Changelog:

- A gate counts only once your whole drone is through. Gates also became one way: a red force field prevents going through in the wrong direction.
- Like in real life, Yaw is now a drone’s slowest axis.
- Drones flying in Gold and Legend are twice as powerful, allowing for acrobatics in acro mode.

Changelog:

- Rotation is calmer and has inertia in both flight modes (ANGLE and ACRO)
- Gates are solid rings: touching one bounces you off.
- Every impact makes you CRASH for longer the harder you hit. It also damages your drone slightly for the rest of the race.
- Bouncing off walls, rings, pylons and other drones makes you lose speed.
- Wood tracks are shorter.
- The inputs now includes each drone's rotation speed.
- Bosses are retrained, and the top bosses use items.
- Viewer update: ring hit effects, a damage gauge, a speed unit setting, a time bank stopwatch, a better mini-map, tooltips and a new intro.
- Statements updated and simplified

I've done a large update to addres all of the feedback so far. I also added hover text, enhanced the mini map, added a soundtrack and sound effects, and visualization for the timebank system (time your bot has left to think for the rest of the game).

I'm now thinking about adding angular momentum, as my best bot move a bit crazily and I'm hopping to get some of cleaner line, just like professional FVP racers, stay tuned!

User test (playtest done with an AI agent for TidyMaze):

Tested: 4 demo games of league 1 (wood) against one opponent, with one C++ bot in ANGLE mode that steers towards the next gate. The bot finished first in all 4 games.

Bugs and points to check:
- Time: the statement says "28000 / playerCount ms in total for the whole race". There is no per-turn time limit, and "does not answer in time" gives no number.
- Gates crossed between two turns: the Rules section says the drone must pass less than 600 from the gate centre, but does not say that a gate crossed during a move counts. Only Expert rule 6 says "Gates are checked along the path". Please move that to the Rules.
- Victory: after 600 turns the ranking of drones still flying is not stated. The rule uses the distance "taken when they were destroyed", which does not exist for a drone still flying.
- League 1 input: cellCount and pylonCount lines are always 0 here. The pylon limits (0 to 4) first appear in level 5.

Good: the radio section gives the stick mapping and both flight modes in one place.
FYI The input changed with the introduction of pylons in gold. Please update your bots.

I haven't read the statement in detail or done any play-testing yet. The following points are based on a quick initial scan:

Defeat Conditions
* The section heading is missing.

What is in store for me in the higher leagues?
* This section is usually placed at the end for a better flow. It also typically features the Wood League icon and a green background, similar to those used in the league introduction section at the beginning.

Initialization input / Input for one game turn
* All lines: Please specify the format and variable types (e.g. 4 space-separated integers, an integer, or 4 space-separated values).

* "Next playCount lines": "Next" can be omitted here.

* Consider putting each description (boostTimer, cutout, etc.) on a separate line.

Output for one game turn
* Please format "One line".

Expert rules
* Will a link to the referee's source code be provided?

Thanks.

Great feedback, thanks Paco.

I've pushed a fix for 1, 2, 4, 5, 6 and 7.

Regarding 3, I didn't want the statement to give everything away, it's already pretty big. If anything I'm wondering what I should remove. Let me know if you think that's a concern.

That's totally understandable 😆

Oh, and it'd be great if you could upload a cover image for the puzzle too.

Thanks.

All sections
* There doesn't seem to be a way to configure league names in a community puzzle, meaning we're limited to levels or divisions within the Wood league. In that case, I'd suggest to revise the names (Wood 2, Wood 1, Bronze, Silver, Gold, Legend) in the statement to avoid confusion.

Rules
* Currently "The radio" is the only section heading. Consider adding more headings to group related concepts and improve readability, and reordering the concepts too if necessary.

* Boost: "used boosts come back one every 40 turns, up to that number": It's unclear what "that number" refers to. Consider changing it to "the starting number".

* CHARGE: Consider replacing "one more boost at once, even above your starting number." with "the number of boosts is increased by <const>1</const> at once, even if this exceeds the starting number."

Input
* To clarify, "Next" can be omitted only when referring to the first inputs of "Initialization input" or "Input for one game turn". Please add "Next" before the following:
  - gateCount lines
  - cellCount lines (Initialization input)
  - pylonCount lines
  - playerCount lines
  - cellCount lines (Input for one game turn)

* Please revise the variable names in this section to match those used in the stub:
  - x => gateX, cellX, pylonX
  - y => gateY, cellY, pylonY
  - z => gateZ, cellZ
  - type => cellType
  - radius => pylonRadius

Output
* Consider swapping the order of "Invalid output" and "Example", as the current ordering makes the example read as though it illustrates invalid output.

Expert rules
* Boosts: The current explanation is a little difficult to follow. Consider rewriting it as follows:

A <action>BOOST</action> takes <const>40</const> turns to restore. Once a cycle completes (<var>boostTimer</var> = <const>0</const>), one boost is restored, and another cycle begins until the starting number is restored.

Then, after cells have been introduced, replace "it" (in "sets it to 0") with "<var>boostTimer</var>".

* Battery: Consider changing "−1" to "reduced by 1", as the current wording could be interpreted as a negative value rather than a decrease.

* "shield and ghost count down, then the cells taken this turn apply (at most one held item).": What does "apply" mean here? I was under the impression that the cells wouldn't take effect until "USE".

* A link to the referee's source code to be provided.

* Just to confirm, will the link still provide access to the bosses' codes?

Thanks.

Thanks, I've released a new version with most of these updates.

For the league names, the multi contributions seem to all be wood + a number. I'll double check what I want to do. I've always loved the bronze/silver/gold/legend classification but if it's not available I'll change.

I had a closer look (built it, read the referee against the statements, ran a few thousand local races plus some full games with the Boss.java files). 
Really impressive work: the flight model, the expert rules and the FPV split-screen viewer are top quality, and I found no referee bug (invalid outputs, timebank timeouts and random/extreme commands are all handled cleanly)!

One issue: the last bosses (PlannerX, identical in levels 4-6) are much weaker than the Bronze boss (Planner). In their own league, PlannerX beats the Bronze boss only ~13% of the time (300 games each in levels 4 and 6, and 1/16 with the actual Boss files). In mirror games it is destroyed in ~75% of races, almost always on an empty battery, often circling a gate it can't pass within 300. So once Bronze is cleared, the higher leagues are easy. Using at least Planner for Silver and distinct, stronger bosses for last leagues would fix it. (I suppose you’re still busy fine-tuning the bosses :))

Minor suggestions:
- When the only opponent is eliminated (timeout/invalid output), the race keeps running until the survivor finishes or crashes; it could end right away.
- Switching to 2 boosts isn’t a proper mechanic; it’s just a setting. The two boosts can be combined in Gold (3 boosts at once, or 2 boosts plus a faster recharge).And the final league would not introduce any new rules.
- Races are long: 25-45% of boss-vs-boss races from Bronze up reach the 600-turn cap. Stronger bots will be faster, but it may be worth keeping an eye on.
- Small dead code: the "ACRO is not available" branch (ACRO is allowed in every league) and the unused GATE_RIM.

Great game, I'd be glad to see it validated! :)

If you’d like to add a new feature to the latest league, however, why not something like: 
Fixed obstacles (pylons). These would be actual columns or solid spheres placed on the track, specified in the initialisation input. Hitting them causes the drone to bounce, and a collision that’s too strong triggers a CRASH, just like when two drones collide. :)

Awesome feedback, thank you.

For the bosses, I was under the impression that during contests CG picks a player bot and promotes as the boss to get to the new league about to open, so I didn't reall put much effort into those. I do have an ACRO bot I can turn into a boss probably.

I'll review the other points, most are actionable without too much work.

As for the CG contests, yes, but there’s no guarantee that your puzzle will be selected for an upcoming contest. And besides, it could even take years :)
Also, aren’t six leagues a bit too many?
Also found the bug for PlannerX, it was done before I added variable gate sizes and assume a large gate than the game, hence missing a lot. Should be fixed in the next update.

Updated the game with most recommendations, including Pylons which is great because they are simple to define (x, y, width).

Also reviewed the bosses, should be better but I'll still work on a stronger legend one this weekend.
By the way, I reduced to 4 leagues since it's all Wood anyway for community contests.
